sentences.text: Nothing was fixed.

Dario is twenty-four and his grandfather is eighty-two and has not spoken to anybody from Fonte, and the road is still twenty-nine kilometres, and the mule track is still under the hornbeam, and there is no version of this story in which two villages made it up because some children met a wolf.
He wants that stated plainly, because he has told this at university twice and both times somebody has tried to give it an ending.
The endings offered were: that the two villages should hold a joint festival, and that Dario and Sara should have got married.
He is not making either of those up.
What happened is smaller and he thinks it is the only kind of thing that actually happens.
He told his grandfather about Sara when he was nineteen.

He did it badly and at the wrong moment, at a table, with people there, and his grandfather went the four degrees down and said nothing for the rest of the meal, and then came and found him in the yard about an hour later and asked one question.
He asked what her grandmother's name was.
Not what Sara was like.
Not what they had talked about.
Not whether Dario had told anybody.
One question, in a yard, an hour later, having plainly thought about nothing else during the meal.
Dario told him.
His grandfather stood there for a bit and then said: "She was two years above me at the school in the valley.
Before all this.
She could sing." And went in.
That is the whole of it and it did not lead to anything.
There was no reconciliation and no visit and his grandfather has not said her name since.

But Dario is twenty-four and Sara is twenty-four and they are in touch about four times a year, and when his grandfather and her grandmother are gone there is going to be one family in Colle and one family in Fonte in which the word does not drop the temperature, and neither of those families will be able to point to a moment when that changed.
The wolf is dead or gone.
The track stopped in the winter of 2019 and there is a photograph from the trap in the February of that year which is the last one, and eleven years is a good run for a wolf.
Both bars still have the photographs up.
Dario checked the one in Fonte in 2023, on the second visit of his life, and it is in a frame by the door and it is the same image as the one in Colle and it has a different caption.
There is another one on the ridge now.
She does not use the mule track.
